Skip to main content Parts Promise Demo Jobs  Privacy Sign in Use dark theme   Privacy — Parts Promise  Privacy How Parts Promise handles data Local data in this browser Jobs, required parts, sources, and allocations are stored in IndexedDB
        on this browser. The live workspace uses parts-promise-live-v1. The sample uses parts-promise-demo-v1. Signed-in firm data A signed-in firm can copy chosen local records to its shared workspace.
        The server keeps firm records separate by organization and records sync
        changes in an audit log. Microsoft Entra handles sign-in. Sociobot and Dodo handle checkout.
        Parts Promise stores no password or payment-card number. The demo is separate Demo records never enter the live local workspace. Reset restores the
        bundled sample. Leaving demo deletes its browser database. Demo requests The demo makes only same-origin GET requests and never asks for camera
        access. Your control Export a versioned backup before moving devices or clearing browser
        data. Browser site-data controls remove local records. Signed-in firms can export server-held data and schedule a 14-day
        deletion hold from Data controls.         Promise job dates from parts held for the job. PrivacyTermsBuilt by Param Factory Account workspace release
